conviction_note: Q3 is not pre-released. A €2.5m Q2 base effect drops out, costs are flat and own-software gross profit grew 11% in Q2, so the quarter should show double-digit EBIT growth, but management already told the market that. Against it: MuM reaffirmed its annual target at Q3 in both 2024 and 2025 and missed both, and H2 2026 needs +18-36% EBIT. The 2027 first guide is the real event and its sign is unknowable. findings.finding: The ~€2.5m Q2 2025 gross-profit bump from Autodesk 1-to-3-year contract switching does not recur in Q3; own-software gross profit grew ~11% in Q2 (€28.61m vs €25.70m) with group opex flat, so Q3 EBIT should grow double digits against a normal Q3 2025 base of €10.42m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Record Q1 2026 (EBIT +13.7%): stock +5.05% on the day. Soft Q2 2026 (EBIT -7.8%): -1.27%. Q3 2025 (9M EBIT -2.4%, targets reaffirmed): -0.99% on the day, -5.11% the next.
findings.original_quote: Das war ein Einmaleffekt aus dem Autodesk-Geschäft, bei dem im zweiten Quartal 2025 durch einen Anreiz viele Kunden von einjährigen auf dreijährige Verträge umgestiegen sind und dadurch rund 2,5 Millionen Euro mehr Rohertrag generiert wurde. ... so dass ab dem dritten Quartal 2026 die dynamische Entwicklung unserer Eigensoftware voll im Konzernergebnis sichtbar werden kann. (Translation: a one-off from the Autodesk business, where an incentive in Q2 2025 moved many customers from 1-year to 3-year contracts and generated about €2.5m extra gross profit ... so from Q3 2026 the dynamic development of our own software can become fully visible in group earnings.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: management said it publicly in July, and the stock sits at ~€35, P/E ~16 on LBBW 2026E, ~6.5% yield. That is skepticism, not belief in an H2 acceleration. If the market believed it, the stock would have recovered from the July levels (36.75 on 27 Jul) rather than drifting lower into the print. It lands inside the company's own guide, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Autodesk EMEA +13% cc in the May-Jul quarter (finding 3) supports the Digitization side from a different source: https://finviz.com/news/386371/autodesk-inc-announces-fiscal-2027-second-quarter-results

findings.finding: MuM reaffirmed its annual target in the Q3 release in both 2024 and 2025 and missed both (2024 EPS 180c vs a reaffirmed 189-206c; 2025 EBIT +5.7% vs a reaffirmed +9-19%). The 2026 guide needs H2 EBIT of €26.4-30.4m vs ~€22.3m in H2 2025 (+18-36%), so a reaffirmation is low-credibility and 'low end' wording or a trim is a live risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When the 2026 guide was cut at the top end in the Feb 2026 prelims (+13-25% to +11-19%), the stock fell 5.14% on the day and 5.54% the next. Reaffirmations at Q3 2024 (+7.25%) and Q3 2025 (-0.99%) did not move it consistently.
findings.why_not_priced: The pattern is visible to anyone who reads the record, and the valuation discount suggests the market already distrusts the guide. That is why this is sized at -1 and not on the 9% guidance scale. What is not priced is whether the company changes the 2026 wording in this release; the flat 20-day tape shows no pre-positioning either way.
findings.independence: The Feb 2026 prelims show the 2024 and 2025 actuals against those targets (2025 EPS 190c, PY 180c; EBIT +5.7%): https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/mensch-und-maschine-software-se-presents-preliminary-figures-2025/9ea12328-5425-46ab-a8c7-ae699a430f0f_en. The Oct 2024 Q3 release shows the reaffirmed 2024 range of 189-206c: https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/mensch-und-maschine-software-se-presenting-q3-report-2024/10966b7b-022c-478f-9fc9-6dbc9a368135_en

findings.finding: The Q3 release is MuM's scheduled first guide for next year (Q3 2023 gave 2024 EPS +14-20%, Q3 2024 gave 2025 +12-25%, Q3 2025 gave 2026 EBIT/EPS +13-25%), so first 2027 targets are likely tomorrow. The anchors are the 2030 plan's +11-19% band and LBBW 2027E EBIT +11%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First-guide days: Oct 2024 +7.25%, Oct 2025 -0.99% (then -5.11% the next day), Oct 2023 small. The sign was not consistent.
findings.why_not_priced: Its content cannot be priced because it does not exist yet. A guide at the top of the plan band would be news on a stock trading at ~16x; one at +11% or below would confirm the de-rating. I have no evidence on which, so it is sized at 0 and carried in abs_move_pct.

findings.finding: Autodesk, whose products drive MuM's Digitization commissions, reported EMEA revenue of $804m, up 13% in constant currency, for the quarter to 31 July 2026, and raised its FY27 billings and revenue guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No MuM print has been traced to an Autodesk datapoint; Digitization segment surprises showed up in the Q2 2026 'Bremseffekt' (-1.27%).
findings.why_not_priced: It is a counterparty number from the US wire that MuM's thin coverage (4 analysts, $0.4m/day) rarely connects to the stock. But it only overlaps MuM's Q3 for one month, it is partly a currency and pricing effect, and Digitization gross profit was down about 5% in Q2 even ex the one-off. So it is a proxy and sized small.
findings.independence: Company statement that Digitization segment EBIT will be at or above prior year for FY2026 (Plusvisionen interview): https://www.mum.de/-/media/mum/downloads/investor-relations/pressespiegel/2026/mum-vorstandsinterview-plusvisionen-2026-07-23.pdf

findings.finding: German machine-building orders (the end market for MuM's OPEN MIND CAM software) rose 7% in real terms over June-August 2026 against the prior year, although August alone was -5% with no large-plant orders.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None traceable; LBBW credited Q2 software strength to CAM/CAD/CAE demand from semiconductor equipment, data centres and defence.
findings.original_quote: Im Drei-Monats-Zeitraum Juni bis August stiegen die Bestellungen um real 7 Prozent (snippet_only; per the search summary: in the three months June-August orders rose 7% in real terms, driven by exports).
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission, so it is a hypothesis and sized small. Orders lead CAM seat purchases with a lag, and the August dip cuts against it.

baseline_tension: No positioning anchor and a flat run-up. The findings lean marginally positive on the quarter and negative on guidance credibility, so they neither agree with nor cut against a lean that is effectively zero.
language_note: The German Plusvisionen interview (23 Jul 2026) quantified the Q2 one-off at about €2.5m gross profit from Autodesk 1-to-3-year contract switching in Q2 2025, and gave a full-year Digitization segment EBIT 'auf oder über Vorjahr'. The English release only called it an '(expected) one-time effect'.

The German LBBW 'Aktie kompakt' note (28 Jul 2026) gave the 2026E/2027E EBIT bar (56/62), the target cut to 51.50 and the CAM demand drivers (semis, data centres, defence); English search returned only aggregator snippets.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' and 'a first guide for a new fiscal year is a scheduled guidance event': abs_move_pct raised from 4.0 to 5.0, because the Q3 release carries the first 2027 guide; the name's small release-day history (median ~1.3%) was not used as a cap.

'A finding about a number already told is worth 0': checked. Q3 is not pre-released (no ad-hoc on EQS), so the reported_quarter finding stays, kept small because the base-effect mechanism was publicly flagged in July.
